skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit Zima wore while traveling through Deity Grypherburg and the surrounding region.
Facing the tailor the Rostov family had sent for, Zima made only one request: that a piece of red cloth be sewn over her chest.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Zima stands among the crowd.
She is no leader whose single word summons hundreds, nor a coward clinging to her own life. That she stands there at all means the banner is still held high.
